history.summary: Relatively new (2021) 603 sqft 1BR in a large Tampines development, priced at $1,575 PSF — ~11% below the $1,767 URA median — with deep 264-txn liquidity. The discount and modern, large 1-bed are positives, but 3.0% appreciation is uninspiring and the listing reports no nearby MRT.
history.rating_rationale: $1,575 PSF is well below the $1,767 median and 264 txns make pricing/liquidity high-confidence, while 2021 build keeps the unit modern. But 3.03% URA CAGR is low (OCR-typical), 1BR is a niche family-district unit, and the blank MRT field signals no walk-up station — Tampines CRL/DTL benefit is not direct here.
red_flags: 1BR is niche in a family-oriented OCR district
No nearby MRT listed — limited transit pull for a 1BR
catalysts: Tampines Regional Centre / CRL+DTL extension in the wider district

history.summary: Genuinely under-priced CDL 1BR in Tampines West (D18/OCR), asking PSF verified ~8% below recent transacted average on a deep, real cohort.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,575 PSF is verified cheap: the project transacted at an average of ~$1,722 PSF over the last 12 months (range $1,559-1,809), so this is roughly 8% below recent comps, consistent with the algo's -5.4% age-adj premium and -9.7% vs-cohort. The cheapness is credible because it sits on a deep panel (264 appreciation txns, 32 cohort txns), not a thin-data quirk. D18 is OCR, the strongest realized forward region (~+4.0%). Built 2021 by CDL with 50+ facilities supports build quality and rental demand near Tampines West MRT (DT31). No red flags. Trailing CAGR of 3.0% is just background, not the case. Held to medium confidence because 1BR yield/exit in mass-market Tampines is competitive and the edge is value, not a dated catalyst.
red_flags: 1BR in a 861-unit mass-market project competes with high resale/rental supply
99-yr leasehold from 2021 - no freehold cushion (neutral, not a forward edge)
catalysts: Tampines West MRT (Downtown Line) within walking distance
OCR region (D18) carries the strongest verified forward appreciation in the backtest
